interpretation_limits: All controls are exploratory one-process observations, not independent precision validation.
Profiler absolute wall costs are perturbed and are not calibration data.
The full trace uses a different heterogeneous N16 workload from fixed-length N64 base controls, so their wall-time difference is not a paired observer-effect estimate.
Sample scope includes GPU completion waits; thread CPU may include driver busy waiting.
GPU durations are interval unions where appropriate, not sums treated as critical-path wall time.
Tracked-kernel gaps are not direct whole-device idle or bandwidth-counter measurements.
Native member arrays show Scheduler mapping order, not directly observed prepared GPU tensor order.
Pre-init pin controls did not persist; only actual-pin labels have observed post-init CPU10 affinity.
The intended main domain retains native all-CPU affinity and GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES unset.
No numerical fit or nominal hardware-rate modification was performed.

key_observations.sample_wait_attribution: hipEventSynchronize and execute-launched GPU work occupy nearly the entire traced Prefill sample interval; the sample-launched GPU kernels occupy only tens of microseconds. Thread CPU time is not evidence of CPU sampling algorithm cost.
key_observations.control_comparison: One process per exploratory condition; actual CPU10 controls are outside the intended native-affinity main domain and do not establish reproducible improvement.
